source: static inspection plus guarded local QA
unit: eligible Work Folder with explicit Task Folder terminal evidence and a real Host Workspace

observed.timingCaveat: Navigation timing includes renderer and route hydration and is not an isolated Host query benchmark. Thirteen is the UI-proven minimum eligible count; rows later omitted by the pure projection may still have issued reads.

decision: Keep event-driven per-workspace reads for the current 20-Work-Folder product envelope; do not add a batched endpoint yet.
batchTrigger: Revisit before supporting more than 20 eligible Work Folders, or when a controlled 20-folder run twice exceeds five seconds to settle all evidence, produces Host worker/backpressure errors, or causes observable input/navigation stalls.
